scenes.en: Quick quiz: which lens is thinnest?
scenes.say: High power, and your glasses feel thick and heavy? Quick quiz. Which lens is the thinnest?

scenes.en: These numbers are the lens index
scenes.say: One point five zero, one point five six, or one point six zero? These numbers are called the lens index.

scenes.en: A higher index bends light more, so the lens can be thinner and lighter
scenes.ta: இண்டெக்ஸ் அதிகம் என்றால் லென்ஸ் மெலிதாக, எடை குறைவாக இருக்கும்
scenes.say: The answer is one point six zero. A higher index lens bends light more strongly, so it can be made thinner and lighter for the same power.

scenes.en: Lenses for short sight are thickest at the edges. That's where thin lenses help most.
scenes.ta: மைனஸ் பவர் லென்ஸ் ஓரங்களில் தடிமனாக இருக்கும்
scenes.say: Did you know? Lenses for short sight are thickest at the edges. That's where a thinner lens makes the biggest difference.

scenes.en: Low power: 1.50 or 1.56. Higher power: 1.60. We'll guide you after your eye test.
scenes.ta: உங்கள் பவருக்கு ஏற்ற லென்ஸை நாங்கள் பரிந்துரைப்போம்
scenes.say: Low power usually works well with one point five zero or one point five six. For higher power, one point six zero keeps it slim. We'll suggest the right one after your eye test.
